title: Beijing Dongyue Temple

terrainReference.basis: Original source terrain in the open courtyard south of the central halls.

mapIdentity.provider: Named native temple boundary and the mapped polygons for its enclosed halls, courtyards and subsidiary pavilions.
mapIdentity.scope: Sixteen native structure outlines across the main temple, the two distinct entrance towers, central joining halls, peripheral courtyards and separate south glazed paifang.

note: OpenStreetMap perimeter controls, six exact public-domain-equivalent Qualla photographs, Beijing municipal architectural descriptions, and the preserved local original terrain samples.
